privacyDescription: How Umbrella collects, uses, and protects your information. This policy applies to all users of umbrella.okaylegal.ai and related Umbrella applications across India, the United States, Kenya, and the United Kingdom.
privacyControllerBody: Umbrella is operated by DVTech Ventures ("we", "us", "our"). We act as the data controller for information collected from consumers and as a data processor for information held on behalf of law firm tenants. Registered address and data-protection contact: support@odaflow.com. For GDPR purposes, our EU/UK representative can be contacted at the same address.
privacyLegalBasisBody: We process personal data under the following legal bases depending on your jurisdiction: (a) Contract — processing necessary to deliver services you have signed up for; (b) Legitimate interests — fraud prevention, platform security, product improvement; (c) Consent — AI training, marketing emails, cookies beyond strictly necessary; (d) Legal obligation — compliance with applicable law. For India, processing is governed by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act). For the UK/EU, processing complies with the UK GDPR and EU GDPR. For Kenya, processing complies with the Data Protection Act 2019. For US users, we comply with applicable state privacy laws including the CCPA/CPRA.
privacyCollectAccountBody: Account data: email address, full name, phone number (optional), country of residence, and password hash. For lawyer users: bar registration number, firm name, practice areas, and jurisdiction.
privacyCollectUsageBody: Usage data: pages visited, features used, AI queries submitted, documents uploaded, time spent, click events, and session recordings (where consent is given). This data is collected via first-party analytics.
privacyCollectDeviceBody: Device and technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system, device identifiers, screen resolution, and timezone. Used for security, fraud prevention, and service compatibility.
privacyCollectContentBody: Content data: legal documents, case descriptions, matter notes, client communications, and AI-generated outputs that you create or submit through the platform. This content is processed to deliver the service and is not used for AI training without your explicit opt-in.
privacyCollectBillingBody: Billing data: subscription plan, payment method type (card brand, last four digits), billing address, and transaction history. Full payment card details are handled by our PCI-DSS-compliant payment processor (Stripe) and are never stored on our servers.
privacyCollectCookiesBody: Cookies and tracking: we use strictly-necessary session cookies, functional preference cookies, and — with your consent — analytics cookies (Vercel Analytics, Sentry error tracking). You may manage cookie preferences via the cookie settings panel.
privacyUseBody: We use collected data to: (a) create and maintain your account; (b) deliver AI legal analysis, matter management, billing, research, and other platform features; (c) process payments and send invoices; (d) send transactional emails (account confirmation, password reset, billing receipts); (e) detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, security incidents, and abuse; (f) comply with legal obligations including court orders and regulatory requirements; (g) analyse aggregate platform usage to improve features (using anonymized or pseudonymized data only); (h) send marketing communications where you have opted in (you may withdraw consent at any time).
privacySharingHeading: 5. Who we share your data with
privacySharingBody: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only as follows:
privacySharingSubprocessors: Subprocessors: we engage third-party subprocessors under data-processing agreements that require equivalent protections. Key categories: (i) Cloud infrastructure — AWS (data hosted in the region closest to your country); (ii) Payment processing — Stripe; (iii) Error monitoring — Sentry; (iv) Analytics — Vercel; (v) AI model providers — OpenAI and DeepSeek (AI analysis and embeddings); Deepgram (meeting transcription) — queries are sent under zero-data-retention API agreements where available; (vi) Email delivery — Resend.
privacySharingLawyerReview: Lawyer review: if you request a lawyer review, your case summary (not full content unless you authorise it) is shared with the assigned licensed lawyer on our marketplace. You control what is shared.
privacySharingLegal: Legal disclosures: we may disclose data when required by law, court order, or regulatory authority, and will notify you unless legally prohibited from doing so.
privacyRetentionBody: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active. On account deletion, we delete or anonymize personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law (e.g., billing records retained for 7 years for tax compliance, audit logs retained for 12 months). Firm tenants may configure custom retention policies up to 7 years via governance settings. AI-training datasets derived from opted-in content are subject to the retention schedule in our Data & AI Consent Policy.
privacySecurityBody: We implement technical and organisational measures including: TLS 1.2+ encryption in transit; AES-256 encryption at rest; role-based access control with least-privilege principles; multi-factor authentication for administrative access; automated vulnerability scanning; penetration testing at least annually; and an incident response plan. In the event of a personal data breach affecting your rights, we will notify you within 72 hours of becoming aware, as required under applicable law.
privacyChildrenBody: Umbrella is not directed at persons under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has submitted data to us, contact support@odaflow.com and we will delete it promptly.
privacyRightsGDPRBody: GDPR / UK GDPR rights (EU and UK users): access — obtain a copy of your personal data; rectification — correct inaccurate data; erasure — request deletion (subject to legal hold); restriction — limit processing while a dispute is resolved; portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format; objection — object to processing based on legitimate interests; automated decisions — not to be subject to solely automated decisions with significant effects. To exercise these rights, email support@odaflow.com or use the in-app privacy settings.
privacyRightsDPDPBody: India DPDP Act rights: right to access, correction, and erasure of your digital personal data; right to grievance redressal; right to nominate a person to exercise rights on your behalf. Contact our Consent Manager at support@odaflow.com.
privacyRightsCCPABody: California (CCPA/CPRA) rights: right to know what personal information we collect; right to delete; right to opt out of sale (we do not sell data); right to non-discrimination for exercising rights; right to correct inaccurate information; right to limit use of sensitive personal information.
privacyRightsKenyaBody: Kenya Data Protection Act rights: right to be informed; right of access; right to rectification; right to erasure and blocking; right to object; right to data portability. Contact our local representative at support@odaflow.com.
privacyTransfersBody: Your data may be processed outside your country of residence. For transfers from the UK/EU, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission and UK ICO. For India, transfers comply with DPDP Act provisions on cross-border data flows. For Kenya, transfers comply with Section 48 of the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019. Enterprise tenants may request data residency restrictions via governance settings.
privacyAutomatedBody: Umbrella uses AI to generate legal analysis, identify issues, and suggest actions. These AI outputs are informational only and do not constitute binding decisions about your legal rights. No fully automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect is made about you without human review. Our AI risk-scoring for fraud detection may affect platform access; you may request human review of any such decision.
privacyCookiesBody: Strictly necessary cookies (session management, security tokens) are always active. Functional cookies (language preference, theme) are set on first use and can be cleared in browser settings. Analytics cookies (Vercel, Sentry) are set only with your consent via the cookie banner. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacyChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified by email and in-app notification at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyContactBody: Data protection enquiries: support@odaflow.com. We aim to respond within 10 business days. If you are unsatisfied with our response you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority: UK — ICO (ico.org.uk); EU — your national DPA; India — Data Protection Board of India; Kenya — Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (odpc.go.ke).
termsDescription: These Terms govern your use of Umbrella — the AI-native legal platform operated by DVTech Ventures. Please read them carefully before using any part of the platform.

If you are using the platform on behalf of a law firm, company, or other legal entity, you represent that you have the authority to bind that entity. If you do not accept these Terms, you must not use the platform. Users must be at least 18 years old.
termsDefinitionsBody: "Platform" means umbrella.okaylegal.ai and all associated applications, APIs, and services. "Consumer User" means a natural person using the platform to understand their own legal situation. "Lawyer User" means a licensed legal professional using the Lawyer OS features. "Tenant" means a law firm or organisation with a firm subscription. "AI Output" means any text, analysis, draft, or recommendation generated by Umbrella's AI systems. "Matter" means a legal case or transaction managed through the Lawyer OS. "DVTech Ventures" or "we" means the operator of the platform.
termsAccountBody: You must provide accurate and complete registration information and keep it updated. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorised access at support@odaflow.com. We reserve the right to disable accounts that violate these Terms or that we reasonably suspect are compromised.
termsPermittedUseBody: You may use the platform to: obtain AI-generated legal information for personal or professional use; manage legal matters, clients, billing, and documents (Lawyer OS); access the lawyer marketplace to connect with licensed attorneys; and integrate the platform with your systems via our documented API.
termsProhibitedUseBody: You must not: (a) impersonate a lawyer, judge, or government official; (b) use AI Outputs as formal legal advice to third parties without lawyer review; (c) submit unlawful, defamatory, or fraudulent content; (d) attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or extract the underlying AI models or training data; (e) resell or sublicense access to the platform without written consent; (f) use the platform in any way that violates applicable law, including data protection, consumer protection, and legal profession rules; (g) submit content that infringes third-party intellectual property rights.
termsSubscriptionBody: Paid plans are billed in advance on a monthly or annual cycle. Prices are displayed in your local currency at checkout and may include applicable taxes. Subscriptions auto-renew at the end of each billing period unless you cancel before the renewal date. Failure to pay may result in suspension or termination of access.
termsTrialBody: Free trials are available for new accounts as specified at sign-up. At the end of the trial period, your account will automatically convert to a paid subscription at the applicable rate unless you cancel before the trial ends. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue trial offers at any time.
termsRefundBody: You may cancel your subscription at any time from account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; no partial refunds are issued for unused time. If you believe you have been charged in error, contact support@odaflow.com within 30 days of the charge. We will review and, if appropriate, issue a pro-rata refund at our discretion.
termsAIOutputsBody: AI Outputs are generated by large language models and are provided for informational purposes only. They do not constitute legal advice, do not create an attorney-client relationship, and should not be relied upon as a substitute for advice from a qualified lawyer. AI Outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate, or out of date. Citations to statutes and cases must be independently verified. You are solely responsible for any action taken based on AI Outputs.
termsNotLawFirmBody: Umbrella is a technology platform, not a law firm. DVTech Ventures does not provide legal advice or legal representation. Use of the platform does not create an attorney-client relationship between you and DVTech Ventures. The lawyer marketplace connects you with independent licensed lawyers; any engagement with a marketplace lawyer is governed by a separate retainer agreement between you and that lawyer.
termsLawyerUsersBody: Lawyer Users are independent licensed professionals. By using the Lawyer OS, you confirm that you hold a valid practising certificate in your jurisdiction and that you will use the platform in compliance with applicable professional conduct rules and bar regulations. You remain solely responsible for the quality and legality of all legal work and advice you provide to your clients. Umbrella provides tools — it does not supervise or guarantee the professional conduct of Lawyer Users.

termsIPContentBody: You retain ownership of all content you submit to the platform. By submitting content you grant DVTech Ventures a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to process, store, and display your content solely to deliver the services. This licence does not extend to AI training unless you opt in under the Data & AI Consent Policy.
termsConfidentialityBody: We treat your content and matter data as confidential and will not disclose it to third parties except as described in our Privacy Policy or as required by law. Lawyer Users must ensure client-confidential communications comply with applicable professional privilege rules. Our systems are architected to isolate tenant data.

disclaimerPageDescription: Important notices about Umbrella's AI-generated legal information, its limitations, and user responsibilities. This disclaimer applies to all products and features offered by DVTech Ventures through the Umbrella platform.
disclaimerScopeBody: This disclaimer applies to every feature of the Umbrella platform, including but not limited to: the Legal Issue Checker, AI Copilot, document review, legal research, matter analysis, strategy memos, draft documents, and any other AI-generated content. It applies to all users — consumers, Lawyer Users, and law firm tenants — across all jurisdictions in which Umbrella operates (India, United States, Kenya, and the United Kingdom).
disclaimerUniversalBody: Umbrella provides legal information, document explanation, issue spotting, and risk analysis. It is not a law firm and does not replace a licensed lawyer. For legal advice specific to your situation, consult a qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction. AI-generated content is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice, legal representation, or the formation of an attorney-client relationship between you and DVTech Ventures.
disclaimerAINotLawyerBody: Umbrella's AI systems are large language models trained on general legal corpora. They do not hold practising certificates, cannot appear in court, are not regulated by any bar association or law society, and owe no duty of care to you as a lawyer would. AI Outputs may: contain factual errors or hallucinations; omit material considerations relevant to your specific facts; cite statutes or cases that have been amended, repealed, or overruled; fail to account for recent legislative changes; and misinterpret complex or ambiguous legal questions. You must treat every AI Output as a starting point for inquiry, not a final answer.
disclaimerCitationBody: When Umbrella cites a statute, regulation, rule, or judicial decision, you must independently verify: (a) that the cited source exists; (b) that the citation is accurate (section, subsection, and year); (c) that the source is currently in force and has not been amended or repealed; (d) that the quoted text accurately reflects the source. AI citation errors — including fabricated citations — are a known limitation of all current AI systems. Never rely on a citation in legal proceedings, advice, or filings without independent verification.
disclaimerNoPrivilegeBody: Communications with Umbrella's AI are not protected by attorney-client privilege or legal professional privilege in any jurisdiction. Do not submit information to the platform that you intend to protect under privilege. If you engage a licensed lawyer through the Umbrella marketplace, privilege may attach to your communications with that lawyer under an executed retainer agreement, but not to your prior AI interactions.
disclaimerRelianceBody: You acknowledge that: (a) you will not rely solely on AI Outputs to make decisions that affect your legal rights or obligations; (b) you will seek independent qualified legal advice before commencing, defending, or settling legal proceedings; (c) DVTech Ventures is not liable for any harm arising from your reliance on AI Outputs without independent verification. This limitation applies to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law.
disclaimerLawyerReviewBody: Certain Umbrella outputs carry an "Attorney Reviewed" badge, indicating that a licensed lawyer on our marketplace has reviewed and approved the content. Even reviewed outputs: (a) reflect the lawyer's opinion at the time of review; (b) do not constitute a formal legal opinion unless accompanied by a signed opinion letter; (c) do not create an attorney-client relationship unless a separate retainer agreement is executed; (d) may become outdated as law changes. The reviewing lawyer is an independent contractor; DVTech Ventures does not guarantee the quality or accuracy of any reviewed output.
disclaimerJurisdictionBody: India: AI analysis is based on central legislation, state acts where specified, and published judicial decisions. It does not account for district court-level practice, local bar customs, or uncodified procedural rules. United States: AI analysis is based on federal law and selected state law. US legal analysis is not a substitute for state-specific licensed counsel. Not available for immigration, criminal defence, or tax matters without verified lawyer review. Kenya: analysis draws on Kenyan statutes, subsidiary legislation, and published High Court and Court of Appeal decisions. It does not account for customary law, magistrate court variations, or unpublished rulings. United Kingdom: analysis covers English and Welsh law. Scots law, Northern Irish law, and devolved matters may differ significantly; seek jurisdiction-specific advice.
disclaimerRegulatoryBody: DVTech Ventures is a technology company, not a regulated legal services provider. We are not authorised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (UK), the Bar Council of India, the Law Society of Kenya, any US state bar, or any other legal regulatory body to provide legal services. The Umbrella platform does not provide regulated legal activity as defined in the Legal Services Act 2007 (UK) or equivalent legislation in other jurisdictions.
disclaimerUserResponsibilitiesBody: By using the platform you accept responsibility for: (a) evaluating the accuracy and applicability of AI Outputs to your specific situation; (b) obtaining independent legal advice where appropriate; (c) ensuring that your use of AI Outputs complies with your professional obligations (Lawyer Users); (d) not submitting third-party confidential information without authorisation; (e) keeping your account credentials secure.
disclaimerNotProvideAdvice: Guaranteed legal advice or predicted legal outcomes
disclaimerNotProvideRepresentation: Representation before courts, tribunals, or regulatory bodies
disclaimerNotProvideSubstitute: A substitute for a licensed, qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction
dataConsentDescription: This policy explains how DVTech Ventures handles your data in relation to AI model training, evaluation, and improvement. It forms part of our overall Privacy Policy.
dataConsentDefaultHeading: 1. Default: no training on your data
dataConsentDefaultBody: By default, Umbrella does not use your documents, case descriptions, matter notes, client communications, AI queries, or any other user-submitted content to train, fine-tune, or evaluate AI models. This default applies to all users — consumers, Lawyer Users, and firm tenants — regardless of subscription tier. Firm training consent defaults to off for all tenants and can only be enabled by a tenant administrator.
dataConsentWhatIsTrainingBody: AI training in this context means using your data — after anonymization and pseudonymization — to improve the accuracy, relevance, or safety of AI models that power Umbrella features. It does not mean sharing identifiable client data with any third party. Training pipelines are operated by DVTech Ventures or its contracted AI providers under data-processing agreements.
dataConsentOptInIntro: If you choose to opt in, you may enable one or more of the following, each independently:
dataConsentOptInPrompt: Prompt improvement: anonymized patterns from your AI queries are used to improve prompt engineering and reduce hallucinations. No personally identifiable information or case-specific facts are included.
dataConsentOptInEval: Model evaluation: redacted samples from your AI interactions are used to test model quality, safety, and accuracy against benchmarks. Samples are reviewed only by authorised DVTech engineers and contracted AI evaluators under NDA.
dataConsentOptInFineTune: Fine-tuning: with admin approval, pseudonymized legal drafts or matter summaries may be included in fine-tuning datasets to improve domain-specific model performance. Fine-tuning datasets require dual-approval by a tenant admin and a DVTech data governance officer.
dataConsentOptInAnonymize: All opt-in data undergoes anonymization (removal of personal identifiers) and pseudonymization (replacement of names, entities, and case references with synthetic tokens) before entering any training pipeline. Anonymization is verified by automated scanning and, for fine-tuning, manual spot-checks.
dataConsentNeverUsedHeading: 4. Data that is never used for training
dataConsentNeverUsedBody: The following data is never used for AI training under any circumstances, including with opt-in: (a) billing information and payment card data; (b) full client names, national ID numbers, passport numbers, or biometric data without complete anonymization; (c) communications protected by legal professional privilege unless the privilege holder provides explicit written consent; (d) data subject to a legal hold or active litigation; (e) health or medical data; (f) data of users under 18 years of age.
dataConsentProvidersBody: Umbrella routes AI queries to third-party AI providers. For analysis and drafting: OpenAI (GPT models) and DeepSeek. For embeddings and document search: OpenAI. For meeting and voice transcription: Deepgram. These providers process your queries under: (a) zero-data-retention API agreements where available (queries are not used to train provider models); (b) data processing agreements that restrict use to service delivery; (c) appropriate cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs for EU/UK; equivalent agreements for other jurisdictions). The specific providers in use for each feature are documented in our subprocessor register available on request.
dataConsentCountryGDPRBody: EU / UK (GDPR / UK GDPR): automated processing that produces legal or similarly significant effects requires a valid legal basis under Art. 22 GDPR. Umbrella does not make binding automated decisions about users. Where AI analysis influences significant outcomes, users are notified and human review is available.
dataConsentCountryDPDPBody: India (DPDP Act 2023): processing of digital personal data for AI training requires explicit consent from the Data Principal. Consent records are maintained and can be reviewed or withdrawn via your account settings.
dataConsentCountryKenyaBody: Kenya (Data Protection Act 2019): automated processing and profiling must be disclosed; data subjects have the right to object. Consent for any AI training use is obtained separately and documented.
dataConsentCountryUSBody: United States: CCPA/CPRA users have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. Umbrella does not sell personal information. Sharing data with AI providers for service delivery is not a 'sale' under CCPA. Sensitive personal information is not shared with AI providers without explicit consent.
dataConsentOptInIntroSection: If you opt in, you may separately enable:
dataConsentFirmLink: Firm training consent (tenant admin — Lawyer OS settings)
dataConsentConsumerLink: Consumer data consent settings (your account settings)
dataConsentManageBody: Consent can be granted or withdrawn at any time via your account settings. Changes take effect immediately for future data processing. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before the withdrawal.
dataConsentWithdrawBody: You may withdraw your consent at any time via account settings or by emailing support@odaflow.com. Upon withdrawal: (a) no further data from your account will enter any training pipeline; (b) previously anonymized data that has already been incorporated into a trained model cannot be removed from that model (as is technically infeasible with anonymized aggregate data, consistent with GDPR Recital 26); (c) any pending training batches containing your data will be purged within 30 days; (d) you will receive confirmation of withdrawal by email within 5 business days.
dataConsentAuditBody: DVTech Ventures maintains an audit trail of all consent events (grant, modification, withdrawal), data flows into training pipelines, anonymization certifications, and third-party processor instructions. Tenant administrators can request a consent audit report via the governance settings dashboard. We conduct annual AI ethics and data governance reviews.
dataConsentRetentionBody: Anonymized training datasets are retained for the period necessary for model development, typically 24 months from creation. Fine-tuning datasets require explicit re-consent after 12 months. Upon tenant account closure, all training data derived from that tenant's content is purged within 60 days.
dataConsentContactBody: For questions about AI data processing, consent, or to request a copy of consent records: support@odaflow.com. We aim to respond within 10 business days.
deleteAccountDescription: Request deletion of your Umbrella Legal AI account and associated personal data on umbrella.okaylegal.ai and the Umbrella mobile app.
deleteAccountStep1: Sign in to Umbrella at umbrella.okaylegal.ai or open the Umbrella Legal AI mobile app with the account you want to delete.
deleteAccountStep2: Use the deletion form on this page while signed in, or email support@odaflow.com from your registered email address with the subject line "Account deletion request".
deleteAccountStep3: Confirm your account email address. We verify that it matches your signed-in account before processing the request.
deleteAccountStep4: After confirmation, your account is deactivated immediately. Personal data is deleted or anonymized within 30 days, subject to legal retention requirements described below.
deleteAccountDeletedBody: When your account is deleted, we remove or anonymize: your name, email address, phone number, password, consumer profile, issue-checker cases, uploaded documents, legal reports, AI outputs and usage logs tied to your account, lawyer profile (solo users), marketplace leads, training consent records, and active session tokens.
deleteAccountRetainedBody: Some information may be retained where required by law or for legitimate business needs: billing and tax records (up to 7 years), security and audit logs (up to 12 months), anonymized analytics that cannot identify you, and law firm workspace data if you were a member of a firm tenant (managed by your firm administrator).
deleteAccountRetentionBody: Most personal data is deleted or anonymized within 30 days of a confirmed deletion request. Backup copies containing your data are purged on a rolling basis within 90 days.
deleteAccountPartialHeading: Delete some data without deleting your account
deleteAccountPartialBody: Yes. You can delete individual issue-checker cases, uploaded documents, and AI conversation history from within the app or web dashboard without closing your entire account. Email support@odaflow.com if you need help removing specific data.
deleteAccountFirmBody: If you belong to a law firm workspace, deleting your personal user account removes your profile and access but may not delete matter or client data held by the firm. Firm administrators should contact support@odaflow.com for tenant-level deletion.
deleteAccountContactBody: Email support@odaflow.com from your registered address. We aim to respond within 10 business days.
deleteAccountFormDescription: Signed-in users can permanently delete their account below. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccountFormSuccess: Your account has been deleted. You have been signed out.
deleteAccountFormSignIn: Sign in to delete your account using the form on this page.
deleteAccountFormMismatch: Email does not match your account.
deleteAccountFormError: Unable to delete account. Try again or email support@odaflow.com.
